subject: Multiple ECDF plots in one graph

messages.author: 1354f0aaefd7d429
messages.subject: Multiple ECDF plots in one graph
parts:
I have trouble plotting multiple ECDF graphs into one. I have people
visiting a facility and for each visit
I know the number of previous visits of that person, representing his
or her experience.

year visits
1 2001 6 - visit in 2001, had 6 previous visits
2 2001 1
3 2001 2
4 2003 0
5 2004 0
6 2003 5
7 2003 0
8 2002 4

Now I want to plot the distribution of previous visits (roughly
modeling the experience of visitors). This is no problem for the
entire data set:

library(ggplot2)
d <- data.frame(year=factor(floor(rnorm(50,2005,2))),
visits=floor(rpois(50,3)))
d <- d[order(d$visits),]
p <- qplot(data=d,visits,seq_along(visits), geom="step")
print(p)

However, I have trouble plotting one curve for each year, all in one
plot. I'd like to visualize the experience of visitors from each year.

-- Christian

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Multiple ECDF plots in one graph
parts:
Hi Christian,

Maybe something like this? The key is to do the sorting and
computation of x value on a per year basis.

library(plyr)
d <- data.frame(
year = factor(floor(rnorm(50,2005,2))),
visits = floor(rpois(50,3))
)

d2 <- ddply(d, "year", function(df) {
df <- df[order(df$visits), ]
df$n <- 1:nrow(df)
df
})

library(ggplot2)
qplot(n, visits, data = d2, colour = year, geom = "step")

Hadley
